description_en: Queries the top source IP addresses of the web resource exhaustion attacks for the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防Web资源耗尽型攻击来源Top IP
name: DescribeWebReportTopIp

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query the domain names for which forwarding rules are configured
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

域名必须已经配置过网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已经配置过网站业务转发规则的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The source of the statistics. Valid values:

visit: indicates all IP addresses.
block: indicates blocked IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的来源。取值：
visit：表示全部IP。
block：表示拦截的IP
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return
parameters.name: top

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which data is collected. Unit: seconds. Valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400.

If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is less than 3 days (3 days excluded), valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400.
If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is from 3 to 31 days (31 days excluded), valid values are 3600 and 86400.
If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is 31 days or longer, the valid value is 86400
parameters.name: interval
